task_name: Chat service — thread and message CRUD

strengths: Clean createChatService factory with dedicated row mappers and truncateTitle helper
All T3 deliverable operations implemented: createThread, findEmptyThread, listThreads, getThread, renameThread, deleteThread, insertMessage, insertAttachment, autoTitleThread
Correction commit (8f47d57) closes write-path IDOR gaps by requiring userId on insertMessage, insertAttachment, and autoTitleThread with ownership pre-checks
Thread read operations consistently filter by user_id; getThread IDOR test present
findEmptyThread uses NOT EXISTS subquery ordered by updated_at DESC for dedup
Hard delete via CASCADE on chat_threads; no soft delete or recordActivity calls
Integration tests gated behind RUN_INTEGRATION=1 and cover all plan-specified scenarios plus renameThread persistence

issues.description: No integration test verifies insertMessage or insertAttachment returns null when userId does not own the target thread/message (correction behavior untested)
deleteMessage, updateMessage, and getMessages (added in T5) lack userId parameters for defense-in-depth; mitigated because routes validate thread ownership via getThread before calling
